correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof verified end-to-end. Starter counts |P0|=r^3, |Pi0|=r^3+r^2+r, K0=r^5+r^4+r^3 and F-line loads (r points, r+1 planes) checked; only-F-lines lemma holds by F-vector cross-product argument. Thinning at rate 1/r gives means r^2, r^2+r+1, E>=r^3 and per-line means 1 and 1+1/r. Chernoff size term 4exp(-r^2/48), Chebyshev term 16/r from Var<=4r^5 (four-factor independence gives Cov=0 for disjoint indices; d-classes bounded by 1/r^4 as valid majorant), and cap union term 6r^4 2^{-c sqrt(r)} with c=2^{-1/4} are all valid upper bounds. Reran output/artifacts/check_bounds.py: M(6561)=2.47e-03<1 with A_lower=68.11>5.44 and monotone decrease for sqrt(r)>13.73, so a good sample exists for every r=3^k>=6561. Greedy low-degree deletion to Ndet=floor(3r^2/4) keeps I'>=I/4>=r^3/8 with m=n=Ndet<=r^3=q^{3/2} and caps Ndet^{1/4} intact. Then I'/(C Ndet^{3/2-1/20})>=r^{1/10}(r^2/Ndet)^{1.45}/(8C)->infinity, defeating every delta>0. Constant-factor phrasing slack (r^{1/10} vs N^{1/20}) was checked to be a valid sufficient lower bound, not an error.

originality.rationale: Live three-form literature search (literal line-capped N^{3/2-delta} with N^{1/4} cap; equivalent K_{2,t}/max-collinear/k-plane duality phrasings and thinned-subfield sampling; dominance query for stronger Rudnev/Vinh/VC-dimension theorems and extremal censuses) fused 20 results. Nearest priors are general UPPER bounds: Rudnev O(m sqrt(n)+m k) with n<p^2, de Zeeuw short proof, Vinh spectral and Stevens-de Zeeuw bounds. With k=N^{1/4} these give O(N^{3/2}), compatible with the disproved saving and not implying it. The classical full-subfield extremal example (F_r^3, r^5 incidences) violates the N^{1/4} cap (load r vs r^{3/4}) so does not imply the capped lower bound. No source states or implies the thinned capped Omega(N^{3/2}) construction with random 1/r sampling plus greedy equalization. Title similarity alone was not counted as coverage; hypotheses and conclusions compared literally.

value.rationale: TARGET route with OPEN decision phase and no preset fallback: a rigorous disproof is a complete two-sided resolution. The result is an infinite family (r=3^k, q=r^2) with capped m=n=Ndet and I>=N^{3/2}/8, so I/(C N^{3/2-1/20})->infinity for every absolute C, indeed defeating every delta>0. This exposes that the N^{1/4} line cap is too weak to force the conjectured polynomial-partitioning saving, a substantive boundary fact for finite-field incidence geometry, motivated before computation. It is not a type/normalization error, vacuity, cheap small-instance mismatch, direct lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact: Ndet<=q^{3/2} holds, thresholds are arbitrarily large, and the ratio diverges. Independently worth retrieving as an exact extremal witness.
